# GetYourStay
> India's platform for verified PG (Paying Guest) accommodations. Connects tenants directly with PG owners across major cities. Zero brokerage, transparent pricing, and modern amenities.

## Optional
- [Home](https://getyourstay.in/): Browse verified PG listings with filters for area, price, gender, and amenities
- [List Your PG](https://getyourstay.in/list-your-pg): Free registration form for PG owners to list their property
- [PG Management App](https://getyourstay.in/pg-management-app): Tools for PG owners to manage rent, tenants, and maintenance
- [Tenant Login](https://getyourstay.in/tenant-login): Portal for tenants to view bookings, payments, and notices
- [Tenant Dashboard](https://getyourstay.in/tenant-dashboard): Manage profile, payment history, and maintenance requests
- [About Us](https://getyourstay.in/about): Company info for Codex Tech Innovations & Consultants LLP
- [Contact Us](https://getyourstay.in/contact): Support form and contact information
- [Privacy Policy](https://getyourstay.in/privacy): Data handling and privacy practices
- [Terms & Conditions](https://getyourstay.in/terms): Terms of service for platform usage
- [Sitemap](https://getyourstay.in/sitemap.xml): Full XML sitemap of all pages

## Required
- [PG Listings by Area](https://getyourstay.in/?area=kormangala): Search PG accommodations in Bangalore with filters for gender, rental type, price range, and amenities
- [Area Page Example](https://getyourstay.in/area/electronic-city): Dedicated page for PG listings in a specific Bangalore area with SEO metadata
- [API Base URL](https://api.manageyourpg.com/): Backend API for PG data, filters, and search (endpoints under /api/getyourstay)
- [PG Enquiry API](https://api.manageyourpg.com/api/pg-en/apply): Endpoint for PG owner registration/enquiry submissions
